title: Biographical details; nickname and birth
description: Doris gives her full name, explains her father called her Mike because he wanted a boy, and provides her birth date and North Dakota birthplace.

title: Migration moves; family background
description: Doris traces the family's moves from North Dakota to Billings, Weiser, Chicago, and Moscow, and describes her parents' work.

title: Farm work; Depression and dust storms
description: Doris discusses her farm chores, driving without lessons, and surviving the Depression by cutting wheat and herding cattle during dust storms.

title: Chicago; nursing career; courtship
description: Doris describes her Chicago years, nursing jobs, meeting her husband in Moscow, and their marriage and early farm life.

title: Used car business; community activities
description: Doris talks about the family car business, building their house, quilting club, skiing, and other Troy community involvement.

title: Children and family; work history
description: Doris describes her three children's education and careers, her nursing jobs, and the development of the family orchard.

title: Free time; economic outlook; women's roles
description: Doris reflects on having little free time, predicts labor and economic difficulties, and comments on how women's roles have changed.

title: Depression memories; Troy changes; orchard work
description: Doris recalls Depression-era details, describes how Troy has grown and changed, and explains the family's pond and orchard work.

title: Skiing activities; future outlook
description: Doris discusses family skiing, her recent lessons, and her views on labor problems and the nation's economic future.

title: Women's roles; childbirth and family planning
description: Doris comments on changing women's roles, discusses having three children after wanting six, and explains her knowledge of childbirth.
